title: Before assignment
explanation: The class relationship is AssociationLearner [0..*] --tutor--> [0..1] AssociationTutor. Read the tutor end as zero or one tutor per learner, and the learner end as zero or more learners per tutor. These two learner objects currently have no tutor link; multiplicity describes allowed links, not the current count.

title: Share a tutor
explanation: Each learner stores the same Mira reference in its own tutor field. Navigability runs from learner to tutor. The tutor has neither a learner field nor a reverse directory; sharing does not create that reverse API.

title: Replace one link
explanation: saved retains the earlier tutor reference. Reassigning Ada to Noor changes only Ada's tutor field. Ben and saved still refer to Mira. The assignment does not copy, rename or delete either tutor.

title: Reject an incompatible link
explanation: Sol teaches SQL while Ada studies Java. The subject check rejects this assignment before writing the tutor field, leaving Ada linked to Noor. Java's reference type alone could not enforce this domain rule.

title: Clear links, keep using tutors
explanation: clearTutor sets each learner's field to null. The demo then calls both tutors through its separate references. This verifies continued use after unlinking, not garbage-collection timing, exclusive ownership or a UML composition lifecycle.
